conversation_shape.name: conversation_shape
conversation_shape.value: ("conversation"."kind" IN ('public','private') AND "conversation"."name" IS NOT NULL) OR ("conversation"."kind" IN ('dm','group_dm') AND "conversation"."dm_key" IS NOT NULL)

message_author.name: message_author
message_author.value: "message"."author_id" IS NOT NULL OR "message"."webhook_id" IS NOT NULL
